message: When Claude reads a task it now sees what missing it costs in blocked apps, any bounty on it, slips logged against it, who it is waiting on, its streak, contact details, what completing it also logs (a dose, a Health reading, a meal) and how often it has been pushed back, so it can warn you before deferring or completing one. A missed occurrence now reads as missed rather than done, a task the app wrote on its own says so, and Claude can set a repeating task to start each occurrence pinned.
